_meaning.n_flies_series: Flies in the severity series (stage_curve_x4.csv, pan-neuronal hub map): 64 healthy + 32 at each of 10 severities.
_meaning.n_flies_components: Flies in the rule ablation (components_x4.csv): 5 conditions x 2 severities (0.5, 1.0) x 32 flies.
_meaning.n_flies_maps: Flies in the vulnerability-map comparison (vulnerability_x4.csv): hub, shuffled, antihub x 2 severities x 32 flies.
_meaning.n_flies_kc_only: Flies with pathology confined to Kenyon cells (scope_x4.csv): 2 severities x 32 flies.
_meaning.n_healthy: Healthy reference flies (stage 0, pan scope, stage_curve_x4.csv) used as the denominator for every % of healthy in this file.
_meaning.series_stages: Severities s of the series (stage 0 = healthy is not listed); s = 1.0 is the end point.
_meaning.healthy_median_brain: Median over the healthy flies (64 flies) of the whole-brain spike count during odour A (1 s; removed neurons contribute none).
_meaning.healthy_median_LH: Median over the healthy flies (64 flies) of the mean lateral horn neuron rate during odour A (Hz; all LH neurons, removed ones counted as silent).
_meaning.healthy_median_PN: Median over the healthy flies (64 flies) of the mean rate of all 686 antennal-lobe projection neurons (class ALPN, removed ones counted as silent) during odour A (Hz); the 8 odour-A uPNs are themselves driven at 150 Hz, so this mostly tracks how many driven uPNs survive (see pn_* keys).
_meaning.healthy_median_KC: Median over the healthy flies (64 flies) of the mean Kenyon cell rate during odour A (Hz; all Kenyon cells, removed ones counted as silent).
_meaning.healthy_median_KCrec: Median over the healthy flies (64 flies) of the fraction of all Kenyon cells (removed ones counted as silent) firing >= 1 spike during odour A.
_meaning.healthy_median_MBON: Median over the healthy flies (64 flies) of the mean MBON rate during odour A (Hz; all MBONs, removed ones counted as silent).
_meaning.healthy_median_valence: Median over the healthy flies (64 flies) of the naive MB valence V_pre_A (approach minus avoidance MBON rates, Hz).
_meaning.healthy_median_LI: Median over the healthy flies (64 flies) of the learning index.
_meaning.healthy_median_LInorm: Median over the healthy flies (64 flies) of the learning index / MBON rate (defined only where MBON rate >= 0.5 Hz).
_meaning.healthy_median_MN9: Median over the healthy flies (64 flies) of the MN9 feeding drive to sugar (Hz; mean of the two MN9 neurons, a removed one counted as silent).
_meaning.healthy_median_GF: Median over the healthy flies (64 flies) of the giant fibre (DNp01) rate to looming (Hz; mean of the two DNp01, a removed one counted as silent).
_meaning.healthy_median_GFlat: Median over the healthy flies (64 flies) of the giant fibre first-spike latency to looming (ms; undefined in flies without a GF spike).
_meaning.healthy_median_PAM: Median over the healthy flies (64 flies) of the PAM rate during odour-PAM pairing (mean over the 15 PAM types of each type's mean rate, removed PAMs counted as silent, Hz); the PAMs are themselves driven by 100 Hz Poisson input during pairing, so this mostly measures the type-averaged fraction of driven PAMs that survive (delivered teaching input), not a circuit response (see stim_PAM_* keys).
_meaning.healthy_KC_max_hz: Highest Kenyon cell rate (Hz, odour A) among the 64 healthy flies; the dotted line of Fig 6E.
_meaning.series_dead_pct_by_stage: Mean % of all neurons removed per fly at each severity of the series (order of series_stages).

_meaning.trend_abs_rho_range_eleven: Range of |Spearman rho| with severity over the eleven circuit readouts (series, all flies).

_meaning.stim_rank_odourA_uPN: Screen-based hub rank of odourA_uPN from results/exp1/screen/*_units.csv type rows (mean_rank = mean u of the type's lost neurons in that fly): [n_lost-weighted mean, [min, max] over fly x type rows, exp1 flies with at least one screen type row of these types, neurons lost within those rows]. Elements [2] and [3] are NOT counts of flies with a loss or of neurons lost: the screen keeps only 450 type rows per fly (400 types inside the fly's chosen classes, largest n_lost first, plus 50 random control types), e.g. the ALPN class lost 4910 neurons over the 48 exp1 flies but only 1214 of them appear in type rows. A mean over lost neurons overweights high u, and the rows are a selected subset, so element [0] is biased upward for heterogeneous types (PAM); LPLC2/LC4 rows pool both sides. Use stim_u_* instead.

_meaning.boot_unstable_bounds: Keys with a reported 4000-resample bootstrap bound that differs by more than 1 percentage point (0.01 for ratios) from the same interval at 40000 resamples: Monte Carlo instability, not a coding error, usually where the per-fly values have a gap that the 2.5th or 97.5th percentile jumps across. Per interval: label, reported lo/hi, range of lo and of hi over the reported seed and 8 further seeds of 4000 resamples, interval at 40000 resamples. Quote such a bound from the 40000-resample value or flag it as unstable.
